findings.evidence: lock a Member account after 5 consecutive failed login attempts within a 10-minute window
findings.rationale: Specifies locking the Member account after 5 failed login attempts, but omits the lockout duration, unlock/recovery procedure, and user feedback.

findings.evidence: notify him by email
findings.rationale: The pronoun 'him' has three plausible antecedents in the sentence (the Librarian, the Member, or the Guarantor), making the email recipient ambiguous.

findings.evidence: TBD minutes
findings.rationale: Uses the placeholder 'TBD' instead of specifying the concrete expiration duration for password-reset tokens.

findings.evidence: user-friendly; easy to navigate; loads rapidly; standard connections
findings.rationale: Relies on subjective, unquantified terms ('user-friendly', 'easy to navigate', 'loads rapidly', 'standard connections') without measurable acceptance criteria.

findings.evidence: at most TBD consecutive times
findings.rationale: Uses the placeholder 'TBD' instead of defining the maximum number of consecutive loan renewals.

findings.evidence: validate item eligibility within 2 seconds and issue the loan receipt
findings.rationale: Describes only the happy path for item eligibility validation at the self-checkout kiosk without specifying system behavior when an item is ineligible or barcode scanning fails.

findings.evidence: the allowed maximum number of active hold requests
findings.rationale: References a numeric cap ('the allowed maximum number of active hold requests') without specifying the actual number.

findings.evidence: borrow up to 8 physical items simultaneously
findings.rationale: Allows a Member in good standing to borrow up to 8 physical items simultaneously, conflicting with SD-009 which caps simultaneous checkouts at 5 physical items.

findings.evidence: 21 calendar days from the checkout timestamp
findings.rationale: Sets the standard loan period for circulating print books to 21 calendar days, conflicting with SD-010 which sets it to 14 calendar days.

findings.evidence: self-register online with only an email address and immediately check out physical books without Librarian ID verification
findings.rationale: Allows unverified visitors to self-register with only an email and borrow physical books without ID verification, contradicting SD-001 which requires a Librarian to verify government-issued photo ID and record full name, email, and phone before account creation.

findings.evidence: remain held indefinitely until the requesting Member explicitly cancels the hold
findings.rationale: States that reserved items on the pickup shelf are held indefinitely until cancelled by the Member, contradicting SD-011 which requires cancelling uncollected holds after exactly 72 hours.

findings.evidence: send an overdue email and/or suspend borrowing privileges and/or apply a penalty flag
findings.rationale: Uses chained 'and/or' connectives, leaving it ambiguous which combination of actions is mandatory when an item is 7 days overdue.

findings.evidence: shall be reviewed, approved, and recorded
findings.rationale: Uses passive voice without identifying which human role or system component is responsible for reviewing, approving, and recording fine waiver requests.

findings.evidence: if appropriate
findings.rationale: Includes the non-binding qualifier 'if appropriate' (and leaves 'before the due date' unquantified), making alert dispatch subjective and untestable.

findings.evidence: for TBD years
findings.rationale: Uses the placeholder 'TBD' instead of specifying the retention period for payment receipts.

findings.evidence: $1.25 USD per overdue day per item with no maximum cap on accumulated fines
findings.rationale: Specifies an overdue fine of $1.25 USD per day with no cap, conflicting with SD-019 which sets the overdue fine at $0.50 USD per day capped at $20.00 USD per item.

findings.evidence: permitted to renew borrowed items online at any time regardless of any unpaid overdue fine balance
findings.rationale: Permits renewing items regardless of any unpaid overdue fine balance, contradicting SD-020 which blocks Members with unpaid fines exceeding $5.00 USD from borrowing or renewing items.

findings.evidence: Patron's active loan count ... Patron profile screen
findings.rationale: Introduces the term 'Patron' instead of the established domain role 'Member' used consistently in earlier requirements such as SD-001 and SD-009.

findings.evidence: quickly; many users
findings.rationale: Uses unquantified terms ('quickly' and 'many users') without specifying target response latency or concurrent user load.

findings.evidence: where possible
findings.rationale: The non-binding loophole qualifier 'where possible' fails to define the concrete conditions under which query-term highlighting is required or exempt.

findings.evidence: sufficient ISBN matching accuracy; acceptable response times
findings.rationale: Uses subjective terms ('sufficient' and 'acceptable') with no quantitative accuracy threshold or latency target.

findings.evidence: efficiently; large batch MARC21 files; noticeable system slowdown
findings.rationale: Uses unquantified terms ('efficiently', 'large', 'noticeable system slowdown') without measurable file size, throughput, or performance degradation limits.

findings.evidence: shall detect the active references
findings.rationale: Specifies only that the Catalog Service detects active loans or holds on deletion attempt, without specifying the resulting action (such as blocking deletion and returning an error).

findings.evidence: at TBD intervals
findings.rationale: Uses the placeholder 'TBD' instead of defining the required backup schedule interval.

findings.evidence: important administrative actions; in a timely manner; an appropriate period
findings.rationale: Relies on subjective, unquantified terms ('important', 'in a timely manner', 'an appropriate period') without enumerating the audited actions or defining logging latency and retention duration.

findings.evidence: If the primary database node becomes unreachable for more than 10 seconds, the Failover Manager shall log event FAILOVER-01.
findings.rationale: Specifies only logging event FAILOVER-01 when the primary database node becomes unreachable, omitting the required failover or recovery behavior (e.g., promoting a standby replica or alerting operators).

findings.evidence: adequate transport security; clear error messages
findings.rationale: Uses subjective terms ('adequate' and 'clear') without specifying concrete security protocols/versions (e.g., TLS 1.3) or testable error message criteria.

findings.evidence: accept any Member password of at least 8 characters
findings.rationale: Accepts any Member password of at least 8 characters, conflicting with SD-002 which requires at least 12 characters containing uppercase, lowercase, and numeric characters.

findings.evidence: active for 60 minutes of user inactivity
findings.rationale: Keeps web portal sessions active for 60 minutes of user inactivity, conflicting with SD-004 which terminates sessions after 15 minutes of inactivity.

findings.evidence: encrypt all Member passwords using reversible AES-256 encryption so Administrators can decrypt and retrieve forgotten passwords
findings.rationale: Requires reversible AES-256 encryption so passwords can be decrypted, contradicting SD-003 which mandates one-way bcrypt hashing (cost factor 12) and forbids storing plaintext passwords.
